title: Take Your Shoes Off Outside
description: Stand on grass, dirt or sand with nothing between it and you. Thirty seconds is plenty.

title: Adopt a Tree
description: Pick one tree within walking distance and photograph it. It is your tree now; check on it in a month and it will have changed without asking you.

title: Report the Weather With No Numbers
description: Write down what today is doing outside without using a single number. No degrees, no percentages, no wind speeds; only what your skin and ears tell you.

rubric.ideal: I can tell it is cold because my ears sting and the puddles have a skin of ice across them.
The clouds are low and moving fast, and the wind keeps shoving the tops of the trees around.

title: Walk Outside After Dark
description: Leave the podcast at home and walk with your screen off. Your eyes take about fifteen minutes to switch over to night vision, so the first half is the boring half.
